name: Swallow-tailed Gull
rangeDescription: Galapagos; winters coastal colombia to chile
description: The antithesis of confusing northern gulls, Swallow-tailed is stunning and distinctive. Breeding adults are mostly pearly gray with a black head, red eyering, pinkish legs, and a pale-tipped bill with a white spot at the base.

name: Snowy-crowned Tern
rangeDescription: Lagoons and marshes of southeastern brazil and uruguay to patagonia
description: Attractive but often rather local tern of southern South America. Favors shallow coastal waters, but also ranges inland locally along rivers and lakes.

name: Buffy Helmetcrest
rangeDescription: Central andes of colombia (quindío and tolima)
description: Large, short-billed hummingbird found only at extremely high elevations in Colombia’s central Andes. Adult male’s green and blue beard, black and buff head pattern, and shaggy crest make him easily recognizable within his tiny world range.

name: Red-crested Bustard
rangeDescription: Southern angola to northeastern namibia, botswana, southern zambia and northern southern africa
description: A medium-sized, black-bellied bustard with diagnostic white chevrons on a brown-and-black mottled back. The male has a brown-gray neck and slaty cap, and the female is plainer.

name: Black-fronted Dotterel
rangeDescription: Australia (except arid areas) including tasmania, and new zealand
description: Small plover with streaked upperparts, strong white eyebrow, and a heavy black line through the eye. Note red eyering.

name: Bolle's Pigeon
rangeDescription: Western canary islands (la palma, gomera, el hierro, and tenerife)
description: Endemic to the Canary Islands, where it is found in laurel and tree heath forests on mountain slopes. Shy and difficult to observe unless flushed.

name: Togian Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Togian islands (off sulawesi)
description: A thrush-sized songbird with a long powerful bill, an olive head and upperparts, a dark eye, and uniform yellow underparts. Juveniles duller and pale-eyed.

name: Olive-naped Weaver
rangeDescription: Senegal to nigeria and western cameroon; bioko
description: A medium-sized, pale-eyed weaver in which males and females are distinctly different, but both are colorful. Note olive-green back and nape and slender black mask through the eye.

name: Grand Cayman Bullfinch
rangeDescription: Grand cayman
description: Endemic to Grand Cayman. A small flocking species of brushy and wooded habitats.

name: Minahasa Masked-Owl
rangeDescription: Hill forest of northern and north-central sulawesi
description: A forest barn-owl with rich rufous coloration over its entire body. Particularly note the rufous facial disk and forecrown to aid identification.

name: Rock Parrot
rangeDescription: Coasts and islands of western and southern australia
description: Attractive small parrot of southwestern Australia. Dull olive-green parrot with yellowish lower belly and limited blue in folded wing.

name: Banded Stilt
rangeDescription: Inland salt lakes of southwestern and south-central australia
description: Large black-and-white shorebird with white head and long straight, needle-like bill, very long pink legs. Adult has prominent copper-colored belly-band, lacking in juvenile.

name: Palau Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Palau (western caroline islands)
description: A distinctive small kingfisher, white below with greenish-blue wings and a purplish-blue back. Shows a greenish cheek, a black eye-stripe extending behind the head, and an orange-rufous cap.

name: Spotted Whistling-Duck
rangeDescription: Sulawesi to new guinea, bismarck archipelago, and southern philippines
description: Small whistling-duck with strongly pale-spotted neck and flanks, dark bill, and gray face. Similar to Wandering Whistling-Duck, but lacks warm rusty coloring, and has pale-spotted rather than dark-spotted breast.

name: Large Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Malay peninsula to northern sumatra, borneo, java, and adjacent islands
description: Largest of the green-pigeons, a stout-billed, heavy-chested, and broad-winged bird. Male olive-green overall, washed in gray, with small orange patch on chest.

name: Humaita Antbird
rangeDescription: Western amazonian brazil (east to the rio madeira), southeastern peru (eastern madre de dios), and northern bolivia (pando)
description: Understory antbird of wet, forested habitats. Males are evenly gray; females are warm brown.

name: Christmas Island-Thrush
rangeDescription: Christmas island (indian ocean)
description: Brown and gray thrush with an orange belly, pale throat, and bright orange bill, eyering, legs, and feet. Inhabits forested habitats across Christmas Island, where it can sometimes be found quite close to human habitation; the only resident thrush on the island, and unmistakable.

name: Rosy Pipit
rangeDescription: Eastern afghanistan to southeastern tibet and southwestern china; winters to southeastern asia
description: An elegant, well-marked pipit that breeds in montane regions, but descends down into meadows and agricultural fields in the winter. Breeding adult is unmistakable with a soft pink throat and breast.

name: Nanday Parakeet
rangeDescription: Pantanal of southeastern bolivia, southwestern brazil, paraguay, and northern argentina
description: Medium-sized, mostly green parakeet with a black hood, red thighs, and blue in the wings and tail. Native to central South America, where it is found in open woodlands and grasslands with scattered trees.

name: Slender Antbird
rangeDescription: Highlands of eastern brazil (southeastern bahia and northeastern minas gerais)
description: Large, long-tailed antbird. Males are gray, paler below, with a black bib.
